summary:
Fixed the stale-read bug.

Changed [handler.go](/app/app/handler.go:78) so `/read` uses `ReadLinearizable` instead of reading local state directly. Also changed [node.go](/app/app/raft/node.go:568) so heartbeat catch-up applies the leader’s commit index after a healed partition.

Verification: `./test.sh` passes all 3 rounds with `PASS: All rounds passed — reads are linearizable`.
